                rest = "|".join(segments[self.cached_pipe_idx+1:])
                # In a real tool we'd use a more robust way to feed the cached output
                # but for this we'll just use a temp file or similar
                cmd = f"echo -n {subprocess.list2cmdline([self.cached_output])} | {rest}"

        try:
            eval_env = self.config.get("eval_environment", ["bash", "-c"])
            res = subprocess.run(eval_env + [cmd], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=2)
            self.stdout = res.stdout
            self.stderr = res.stderr
            self.exit_code = res.returncode
        except Exception as e:
            self.stdout = ""
            self.stderr = str(e)
            self.exit_code = 1

def main(stdscr):
    curses.start_color()
    curses.use_default_colors()
    curses.init_pair(1, curses.COLOR_WHITE, -1)
    curses.init_pair(2, curses.COLOR_CYAN, -1)
    curses.init_pair(3, curses.COLOR_GREEN, -1)
    curses.init_pair(4, curses.COLOR_RED, -1)
    
    # Parse args
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    initial_cmd = ""
    out_file = None
    if "-d" in args:
        initial_cmd = args[args.index("-d") + 1]
    elif "--default" in args:
        initial_cmd = args[args.index("--default") + 1]
    if "-o" in args:
        out_file = args[args.index("-o") + 1]
    
    app = App(initial_cmd, out_file, False, True)
    
    stdscr.nodelay(True)
    
    while True:
        if app.autoeval:
            app.evaluate()
        
        stdscr.clear()
        h, w = stdscr.getmaxyx()
        
        cmd_lines = app.command.splitlines() if app.command else [""]
        cmd_h = len(cmd_lines) + 2
        
        title = "Command"
        if app.autoeval: title += " [Autoeval]"
        if app.cached_pipe_idx is not None: title += " [Caching]"
        
        # Draw Command box
        stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(2))
        stdscr.addstr(0, 0, "┌" + "─" * (w - 2) + "┐")
        for i in range(1, cmd_h - 1):
            stdscr.addstr(i, 0, "│")
            stdscr.addstr(i, w - 1, "│")
        stdscr.addstr(cmd_h - 1, 0, "└" + "─" * (w - 2) + "┘")
        stdscr.addstr(0, 2, f" {title} ")
        stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(2))
        
        for i, line in enumerate(cmd_lines):
            stdscr.addstr(i + 1, 1, line[:w-2])
            
        # Draw Output/Stderr
        out_y = cmd_h
        if app.exit_code != 0 and app.stderr:
            out_h = (h - cmd_h - 1) // 2
            # Output box
            stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(2))
            stdscr.addstr(out_y, 0, "┌" + "─" * (w - 2) + "┐")
            for i in range(1, out_h - 1):
                stdscr.addstr(out_y + i, 0, "│")
                stdscr.addstr(out_y + i, w - 1, "│")
            stdscr.addstr(out_y + out_h - 1, 0, "└" + "─" * (w - 2) + "┘")
            stdscr.addstr(out_y, 2, " Output ")
            stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(2))
            
            # Stderr box
            err_y = out_y + out_h
            err_h = h - err_y - 1
            stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(2))
            stdscr.addstr(err_y, 0, "┌" + "─" * (w - 2) + "┐")
            for i in range(1, err_h - 1):
                stdscr.addstr(err_y + i, 0, "│")
                stdscr.addstr(err_y + i, w - 1, "│")
            stdscr.addstr(err_y + err_h - 1, 0, "└" + "─" * (w - 2) + "┘")
            stdscr.addstr(err_y, 2, " Stderr ")
            stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(2))
            
            # Fill content
            for i, line in enumerate(app.stdout.splitlines()[:out_h-2]):
                stdscr.addstr(out_y + 1 + i, 1, line[:w-2])
            for i, line in enumerate(app.stderr.splitlines()[:err_h-2]):
                stdscr.addstr(err_y + 1 + i, 1, line[:w-2])
        else:
            out_h = h - cmd_h - 1
            stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(2))
            stdscr.addstr(out_y, 0, "┌" + "─" * (w - 2) + "┐")
            for i in range(1, out_h - 1):
                stdscr.addstr(out_y + i, 0, "│")
                stdscr.addstr(out_y + i, w - 1, "│")
            stdscr.addstr(out_y + out_h - 1, 0, "└" + "─" * (w - 2) + "┘")
            stdscr.addstr(out_y, 2, " Output ")
            stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(2))
            for i, line in enumerate(app.stdout.splitlines()[:out_h-2]):
                stdscr.addstr(out_y + 1 + i, 1, line[:w-2])
        
        stdscr.addstr(h-1, w-10, "Help: F1")
        
        # Menus
        if app.active_menu:
            menu_w = 60
            menu_h = 15
            menu_x = (w - menu_w) // 2
            menu_y = (h - menu_h) // 2
            stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(2))
            stdscr.addstr(menu_y, menu_x, "┌" + "─" * (menu_w - 2) + "┐")
            for i in range(1, menu_h - 1):
                stdscr.addstr(menu_y + i, menu_x, "│")
                stdscr.addstr(menu_y + i, menu_x + menu_w - 1, "│")
            stdscr.addstr(menu_y + menu_h - 1, menu_x, "└" + "─" * (menu_w - 2) + "┘")
            stdscr.addstr(menu_y, menu_x + 2, f" {app.active_menu.capitalize()} ")
            stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(2))
            
            items = []
            if app.active_menu == "history": items = app.history
            elif app.active_menu == "bookmarks": items = app.bookmarks
            elif app.active_menu == "help": items = ["F1: Help", "F2: Toggle Autoeval", "F4: History", "F7: Cache", "Esc: Back"]
            
            for i, item in enumerate(items[-(menu_h-2):]):
                stdscr.addstr(menu_y + 1 + i, menu_x + 1, item[:menu_w-2])

        # Cursor position
        tmp_pos = 0
        cur_y, cur_x = 0, 0
        for i, line in enumerate(cmd_lines):
            if tmp_pos + len(line) >= app.cursor_pos:
                cur_y = i
                cur_x = app.cursor_pos - tmp_pos
                break
            tmp_pos += len(line) + 1
        else:
            cur_y = len(cmd_lines) - 1
            cur_x = len(cmd_lines[-1])
        stdscr.move(cur_y + 1, cur_x + 1)
        
        try:
            key = stdscr.getch()
        except:
            continue
            
        if key == -1:
            time.sleep(0.05)
            continue
            
        if key == 27: # ESC
            if app.active_menu:
                app.active_menu = None
            else:
                if out_file:
                    with open(out_file, "w") as f:
                        f.write(app.command)
                if app.command and (not app.history or app.command != app.history[-1]):
                    app.history.append(app.command)
                    app.save_history()
                break
        elif key == curses.KEY_BACKSPACE or key == 127:
            if app.cursor_pos > 0:
                app.command = app.command[:app.cursor_pos-1] + app.command[app.cursor_pos:]
                app.cursor_pos -= 1
        elif key == curses.KEY_DC: # Delete
            if app.cursor_pos < len(app.command):
                app.command = app.command[:app.cursor_pos] + app.command[app.cursor_pos+1:]
        elif key == curses.KEY_LEFT:
            app.cursor_pos = max(0, app.cursor_pos - 1)
        elif key == curses.KEY_RIGHT:
            app.cursor_pos = min(len(app.command), app.cursor_pos + 1)
        elif key == curses.KEY_UP:
            pass
        elif key == curses.KEY_DOWN:
            pass
        elif key == curses.KEY_F1:
            app.active_menu = "help"
        elif key == curses.KEY_F2:
            app.autoeval = not app.autoeval
        elif key == curses.KEY_F4:
            app.active_menu = "history"
        elif key == curses.KEY_F7:
            # Simple pipe finding
            pipes = [i for i, c in enumerate(app.command) if c == '|']
            for p_idx, p_pos in enumerate(pipes):
                if p_pos == app.cursor_pos:
                    if app.cached_pipe_idx == p_idx:
                        app.cached_pipe_idx = None
                        app.cached_output = None
                    else:
                        app.cached_pipe_idx = p_idx
                        # evaluate prefix
                        cmd_prefix = "|".join(app.command.split('|')[:p_idx+1])
                        res = subprocess.run(["bash", "-c", cmd_prefix], capture_output=True, text=True)
                        app.cached_output = res.stdout
                    break
        elif key == 10: # Enter
            if not app.autoeval:
                app.evaluate()
        elif 32 <= key <= 126:
            app.command = app.command[:app.cursor_pos] + chr(key) + app.command[app.cursor_pos:]
            app.cursor_pos += 1
